Hi Sarah — I need to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. I'd like to keep it to 30 minutes. Looking at my week, the gaps I have are:

- Mon 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30

Which of those works for you? If none do, tell me a time that suits you and I'll see what I can move.

Hello — I'm setting up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week (week of Nov 23). Could you tell me whether the official department schedule has anything next week that touches CSE455 (lectures, seminars, university meetings)? I want to avoid a clash before I fix a time.

Hello. Nothing in next week's official schedule (week of Nov 23) has been cancelled or moved. Here is what touches CSE455:

**CSE455**
- Mon 14:30–15:20 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- Mon 16:30–17:00 office hours (Prof. Alvarez)
- Tue 09:00–10:30 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- Tue 12:20–13:30 office hours (Prof. Alvarez)
- Tue 15:30–16:20 office hours
- Tue 16:20–17:00 quiz section
- Wed 10:30–12:00 office hours
- Wed 13:30–14:20 quiz section
- Fri 13:20–14:30 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- Fri 15:20–17:00 office hours (Prof. Alvarez)

Also, guest lecture prep (Prof. Alvarez) is scheduled Mon 16:30–17:00, Tue 16:30–17:00, Wed 13:30–14:30 and Thu 09:00–09:50.

**Department/university meetings**
- Mon 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee · Mon 15:20–16:30 Faculty meeting
- Tue 10:30–11:00 Faculty meeting · Tue 13:30–14:20 Thesis committee
- Thu 13:40–14:40 Curriculum committee
- Fri 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee · Fri 14:30–15:20 Faculty meeting

**Seminars/colloquia**
- Mon 13:00–14:00 Colloquium · Mon 14:10–15:40 Seminar
- Tue 09:50–11:10 Seminar
- Wed 14:30–16:00 Department seminar
- Thu 09:50–11:10 Department seminar · Thu 15:30–17:00 Colloquium
- Fri 12:30–13:20 Colloquium · Fri 14:50–15:50 Seminar

I don't know anyone's private appointments, and I don't fix times for other people's meetings — this is just the official schedule.
Hi Professor — Tue 15:00-15:30 works for me. I've put the CSE455 staff meeting in my calendar then, 30 minutes. See you Tuesday.

Correction before you pick — I've just cross-checked the official department schedule for next week, and two of the slots I offered don't hold: Mon 14:00–14:30 has a seminar (14:10–15:40) and Tue 11:00–11:30 runs into the Tuesday seminar (ends 11:10). Sorry about that.

The 30-minute slots that really are free are:

- Mon 10:00–10:30
- Tue 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30
- Wed 13:00–13:30

Wednesday 13:00–13:30 or Monday 10:00–10:30 are my preference. Which suits you?

No problem — Tue 15:00-15:30 is still free on my side and it's the one I already booked, so let's keep that. It sits between my CSE452 lecture and my CSE455 office hours, so no clash. See you Tuesday at 15:00.
Perfect — Tue 15:00–15:30 it is, and no clash on my side either (my correction crossed with your reply; the slot is clear). It's in my calendar. Thanks, Sarah.
Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. I've settled the staff meeting for Tue 15:00–15:30, which is clear of everything on your list. No further help needed.
You're welcome — glad it helped. Noted: CSE455 staff meeting, Tue 15:00–15:30.
